posts.body:
Hey I m trying to prepare for my lil ones arrival ... I am breaking my head about which body and hair wash to buy? I would like something that I can easily buy from the supermarkets or the like .. Don't want to spend $$$ on it 

Any recommendations ? And which baby oil do you use for baby massages apart from Johnson's!

Thanks !!!

posts.body: i used to suggest 1st pressing Olive Oil but recently cared for a baby with very dry skin and the skin soecialist suggested that it was too heavy and to use a good quality sunflower oil. This made quite a big difference and the babys skin looked a lot better...no eed patches or spots

posts.body: I always use QV wash - a very little bit if any, or just plain water to begin with. My first two got eczema with Johnsons. To moisturise I use a tiny bit of olive oil, or sorbolene (aqueous cream) when a bit older.
